title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy criminal-history screening
requirement: Housing providers must not deny housing through a blanket policy on arrests or convictions; they must disregard arrests without conviction, relieved convictions, juvenile records and convictions more than five years old, and assess applicants case by case.
coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or with income restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy.

applicability.other: DND-funded or BPDA income-restricted housing providers

exemptions: Does not apply where a conviction has a direct relationship to the housing sought or poses unreasonable risk of substantial harm to others; does not apply to current criminal behavior.
citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy: criminal history screening
quoted_span:
a) Arrests that did not result in conviction. This includes dismissed charges, diversion
programs, and similar non-convictions.
b) Convictions that are subject to a form of judicial relief, such as expungement, sealing,
and certificates for relief from disabilities.
c) Juvenile records
d) A conviction more than 5 years old.
interaction: Federal or state criminal-history requirements that conflict preempt this policy.

title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy credit screening
requirement: The agent agrees not to use an applicant credit score to approve or deny housing applications; credit history may be used only in lieu of rental history to judge ability to pay rent.
key_value: credit score prohibited; credit history only in lieu of rental history
coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or with income restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy.

applicability.other: DND-funded or BPDA income-restricted housing providers

exemptions: Lack of credit history, as opposed to poor credit history, is not sufficient justification to reject an applicant.
citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy: credit score and credit history
quoted_span:

title: H.3744 petition to authorize Boston rent stabilization
requirement: Petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization. The packet states no rent cap formula, percentage or coverage test.
coverage_conditions: Would apply within the city of Boston if authorized; the packet names no buildings, unit counts or property types.
quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
interaction: State special law would be required before Boston could adopt rent stabilization.

title: H.3744 petition to authorize Boston tenant eviction protections
requirement: Petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement tenant eviction protections. No allowed causes, notice periods or relocation amounts are stated in the packet.
coverage_conditions: Would apply within the city of Boston if authorized; the packet names no buildings, unit counts or tenancy types.
quoted_span: that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
interaction: State authorization would be required before Boston could adopt eviction protections.

title: Boston source-of-income and rental assistance protections
requirement: A landlord may not refuse to rent to an applicant because they use rental assistance, including Section 8, social security disability or veterans vouchers.
coverage_conditions: All housing in the City of Boston, including renting, buying, selling and securing financing.
citation: Boston Fair Housing Regulations: source of income and voucher protections
quoted_span:
The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance. This includes Section
8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, and veterans vouchers.

title: Housing Stability Notification Act notice to tenant
requirement: All landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources at the same time as the notice to quit or lease non-renewal.
coverage_conditions: All landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement in the City of Boston; the notice is available in 12 languages.

applicability.other: all landlords ending a tenancy in Boston

penalty: First offense: warning. Second and subsequent offenses: $300 per day. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
citation: Housing Stability Notification Act, Sec. 10-11.7: notice to tenant with notice to quit
quoted_span:

title: Housing Stability Notification Act landlord filing with the City
requirement: Landlords and foreclosing owners must use the City’s online portal to submit tenant contact information and upload a copy of the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease.
coverage_conditions: All landlords and foreclosing owners ending a tenancy in the City of Boston who must file the Notice to Quit / Non-renewal of Lease submission form.

applicability.other: all landlords and foreclosing owners in Boston

penalty: Failure to submit this information may result in a fine up to $300 per day.
citation: Housing Stability Notification Act, Sec. 10-11.7: online submission to the City
quoted_span:

title: Housing Stability Notification Act tenant notice, coverage and exemptions
requirement: Any landlord planning to end a tenancy must give the Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources when starting eviction or declining to renew, delivered at the same time as the Notice to Quit.
coverage_conditions: All landlords and foreclosing owners intending to end a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in the City of Boston; also applies to former owners asked to leave.

applicability.other: all landlords and foreclosing owners ending a tenancy in Boston

exemptions: Residences in any hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility, and residences in a non-profit facility whose primary purpose is short-term treatment, assistance or therapy for alcohol, drug or other substance abuse.
penalty: First offense: warning. Second and subsequent offenses: $300 per day. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
citation: Housing Stability Notification Act, Sec. 10-11.7: tenant notice, coverage and exemptions
quoted_span:
The HSNA requires that landlords give this Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources
to tenants when the landlord starts the eviction process, or when the landlord
decides to not offer the tenant a renewal of their lease agreement. The Notice of
Tenants’ Rights and Resources must be delivered at the same time as the Notice to
Quit.

title: Housing Stability Notification Act notice copy to Office of Housing Stability
requirement: Landlords and foreclosing owners must send a copy of the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease with a Certificate of Compliance/Service to the City of Boston’s Office of Housing Stability.
coverage_conditions: All landlords and foreclosing owners ending a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in the City of Boston.

applicability.other: all landlords and foreclosing owners in Boston

exemptions: Requirements may not be waived; any lease term purporting to waive or limit rights under the Ordinance is unenforceable and void.
penalty: First offense: warning. Second and subsequent offenses: $300 per day.
